mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, email, password_hash, role, plan_type, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{role}, #{planType}, #{enabled}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET username = #{username}, email = #{email}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, role = #{role}, plan_type = #{planType}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET enabled = CASE WHEN enabled IS NULL OR enabled = FALSE THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET role = #{role}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET plan_type = #{planType}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
